-- Protected theorem statements

theorem ContractGraph.checkEdge_sound :
  ∀ (source target : ContractGraph.Node),
  Eq (ContractGraph.checkEdge source target) ContractGraph.CheckResult.consistent →
    ∀ (c : ContractGraph.Constraint),
      List.instMembership.mem source.postconditions c →
        ∀ (d : ContractGraph.Constraint),
          List.instMembership.mem target.preconditions d → Eq c.kind d.kind → ContractGraph.constraintImplies c d

theorem ContractGraph.checkEdgeAll_sound :
  ∀ (source target : ContractGraph.Node),
  (∀ (r : ContractGraph.CheckResult),
      List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.checkEdgeAll source target) r →
        Eq r ContractGraph.CheckResult.consistent) →
    ∀ (c : ContractGraph.Constraint),
      List.instMembership.mem source.postconditions c →
        ∀ (d : ContractGraph.Constraint),
          List.instMembership.mem target.preconditions d → Eq c.kind d.kind → ContractGraph.constraintImplies c d

theorem ContractGraph.checkEdgeAll_sound_noErrors :
  ∀ (source target : ContractGraph.Node),
  (∀ (r : ContractGraph.CheckResult),
      List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.checkEdgeAll source target) r → Eq r.isError Bool.false) →
    ∀ (c : ContractGraph.Constraint),
      List.instMembership.mem source.postconditions c →
        ∀ (d : ContractGraph.Constraint),
          List.instMembership.mem target.preconditions d → Eq c.kind d.kind → ContractGraph.constraintImplies c d

theorem ContractGraph.checkPath_sound :
  ∀ (path : List ContractGraph.Edge),
  Ne path List.nil →
    (∀ (r : ContractGraph.CheckResult),
        List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.checkPath path) r → Eq r ContractGraph.CheckResult.consistent) →
      ContractGraph.stepwiseSound path

theorem ContractGraph.checkPath_sound_noErrors :
  ∀ (path : List ContractGraph.Edge),
  Ne path List.nil →
    (∀ (r : ContractGraph.CheckResult),
        List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.checkPath path) r → Eq r.isError Bool.false) →
      ContractGraph.stepwiseSound path

theorem ContractGraph.enumeratePaths_complete :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) (p : List ContractGraph.Edge),
  ContractGraph.IsDataPath g p → List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.enumeratePaths g) p

theorem ContractGraph.closedStates_checkPath :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) (ex : ContractGraph.Explored),
  Eq (ContractGraph.closedStates (ContractGraph.searchSetup g) g ex) Bool.true →
    ∀ (p : List ContractGraph.Edge),
      ContractGraph.IsDataPath g p →
        ∀ (x : ContractGraph.CheckResult),
          List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.checkPath p) x →
            Exists fun r =>
              And (List.instMembership.mem ex.recs.toList r) (List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.checkHop r.hop) x)

theorem ContractGraph.runChecker_sound :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) {maxStates maxPerEdge : Nat},
  Eq (ContractGraph.runChecker g maxStates maxPerEdge).exitCode 0 →
    ∀ (p : List ContractGraph.Edge),
      ContractGraph.IsDataPath g p →
        And (List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.enumeratePaths g) p) (ContractGraph.stepwiseSound p)

theorem ContractGraph.runChecker_sound_all :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) {maxStates maxPerEdge : Nat},
  Eq (ContractGraph.runChecker g maxStates maxPerEdge).exitCode 0 →
    ∀ (p : List ContractGraph.Edge), ContractGraph.IsDataPath g p → ContractGraph.stepwiseSound p

theorem ContractGraph.runChecker_exitCode_eq_zero_iff :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) (maxStates : optParam Nat ContractGraph.defaultMaxStates)
  (maxPerEdge : optParam Nat ContractGraph.defaultMaxPerEdge),
  Iff (Eq (ContractGraph.runChecker g maxStates maxPerEdge).exitCode 0)
    (∀ (e : ContractGraph.ResultEntry),
      List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.runChecker g maxStates maxPerEdge).results e → Ne e.severity "error")

theorem ContractGraph.runCheckerPaths_exitCode_eq_zero_iff :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) (maxPaths : optParam Nat ContractGraph.defaultMaxPaths),
  Iff (Eq (ContractGraph.runCheckerPaths g maxPaths).exitCode 0)
    (∀ (e : ContractGraph.ResultEntry),
      List.instMembership.mem (ContractGraph.runCheckerPaths g maxPaths).results e → Ne e.severity "error")

theorem ContractGraph.incompleteWith_exitCode :
  ∀ (g : ContractGraph.ContractGraph) (m : String), Eq (ContractGraph.incompleteWith g m).exitCode 2
